steps.title: Prepare maintenance culture medium
steps.instruction: Mix 500 mL DMEM with 50 mL (9.1 %) BVDV antibody‑free FBS and 5 mL (1 %) penicillin‑streptomycin; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Prepare 2% FBS culture medium
steps.instruction: Mix 500 mL DMEM with 10 mL (2 %) BVDV antibody‑free FBS and 5 mL (1 %) penicillin‑streptomycin; store at room temperature.

steps.title: Purify viral RNA from infected serum
steps.instruction: Using the PureLink™ RNA Mini kit, extract total RNA from 100 µL serum stored at –80 °C according to the manufacturer’s protocol (General note 1).

steps.title: Reverse transcribe RNA to cDNA
steps.instruction: Combine 16 µL purified RNA with 4 µL SuperScript™ IV VILO™ master mix, then incubate 25 °C for 10 min, 50 °C for 10 min, and 85 °C for 5 min.

steps.title: Amplify viral genome fragments by PCR
steps.instruction: Set up a 30 µL PCR for each fragment using 1 µL cDNA, 1.5 µL forward primer (10 µM), 1.5 µL reverse primer (10 µM), 25 µL KOD One® PCR master mix, and 21 µL H₂O. Run: 98 °C 10 s (30 cycles), 50 °C 5 s, 68 °C 40 s, final extension 68 °C 4 min, hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Verify fragment sizes via gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Run each PCR product on an agarose gel alongside a 1 kb DNA ladder (TAKARA BIO, 3412A) to confirm expected fragment lengths.

steps.title: Purify PCR fragments
steps.instruction: Purify the gel‑extracted fragments using the FastGene Gel/PCR Extraction kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Quantify DNA concentration
steps.instruction: Measure the concentration of each purified fragment with a NanoDrop spectrophotometer.

steps.title: Assemble circular cDNA by CPER
steps.instruction: Mix each BVDV fragment and the linker at 0.1 pmol per fragment; add 4 µL dNTP mix, 10 µL 5× PrimeSTAR GXL buffer, 1 µL PrimeSTAR GXL DNA polymerase, and H₂O up to 50 µL. Thermocycle: 98 °C 2 min; 20 cycles of 98 °C 10 s, 55 °C 15 s, 68 °C 12 min; final extension 68 °C 12 min; hold 4 °C.

steps.title: Co‑culture MDBK and 293T cells
steps.instruction: One day before transfection, seed MDBK and Lenti‑X 293T cells together at a 2:1 ratio (7 × 10⁵ total cells per well) in a collagen‑coated 6‑well plate with maintenance medium. When cells reach ~80 % confluence, replace medium with 2 % FBS medium.

steps.title: Transfect cells with CPER product
steps.instruction: Immediately after CPER, add 25 µL CPER reaction to 200 µL Opti‑MEM (37 °C) and mix; add 12 µL TransIT‑LT1, mix slowly; centrifuge at 5,000 × g for a few seconds, incubate 10 min; add the entire mixture to the cells and incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂, humidified.

steps.title: Harvest virus‑containing supernatant
steps.instruction: Four days post‑transfection, collect 100 µL of culture supernatant into a flat‑bottom microtube and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Inoculate MDBK cells for immunofluorescence
steps.instruction: Seed fresh MDBK cells in a collagen‑coated 24‑well plate to reach 80 % confluence, then add 100 µL harvested supernatant to each well.

steps.title: Fix and stain infected cells
steps.instruction: After 5 days infection, wash cells with D‑PBS, fix with acetone for 10 min at 4 °C, wash D‑PBS three times (plate may be stored at 4 °C). Incubate with anti‑pestiviral NS3 antibody (1:1,000 in D‑PBS) 1 h at 37 °C, wash D‑PBS three times, incubate with goat anti‑mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 488 secondary (1:1,000 in D‑PBS) 1 h at room temperature in the dark, wash D‑PBS four times.

steps.title: Visualize fluorescence under microscope
steps.instruction: Observe stained cells using a fluorescence microscope equipped with a BX‑Z GFP filter; capture images as needed.
